summary.text: Son of Bias (`bias-trojan`) whom Achilles thrust from his chariot to the ground with a cast of his spear when the son of Peleus raged in the rout — distinct from Laogonus son of Onetor (`laogonus-onetorid`), priest of Idaean Zeus, whom Meriones slew in *Iliad* 16.

story.text: Then setting upon Laogonus and Dardanus, sons twain of Bias, Achilles thrust them both from their chariot to the ground, smiting the one with a cast of his spear and the other with his sword in close fight.
